cells.gaps: The strategy's period ended in 2025, before the as-at, and no row records a successor sector policy announced, in drafting or validated. No text, delivery plan or dated adoption has been found, and no dated event falls in the last twelve months. SDN-008 to SDN-011 are on the information society strategy adopted in 2007, whose last five-year plan ran to 2016; it is an older instrument and sets nothing.
cells.note: National ICT Strategy 2021-2025: adopted, but its period ended in 2025 with no successor sector policy in preparation, so stage 2 is not met and the cell is unplaced and lapsed. A national digital strategy is held, which is a noted class and places nothing.
